variant.name: AcceptedAtLeastOnce
variant.summary: The user has accepted at least one suggestion in the past.

variant.name: AcceptedLastTime
variant.summary: The user accepted the suggestion the last time they saw one.

variant.name: FirstImpression
variant.summary: The user is seeing the contextual cue for the first time.

variant.name: RejectedLastTime
variant.summary: The user rejected or ignored the suggestion the last time they saw one.

variant.name: SawCuesButNeverAccepted
variant.summary: The user has seen suggestions in the past but has never accepted one.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance
histogram.summary: Records the overall user acceptance outcome (from Cue or Omnibox) for Multistep Filter suggestion. Recorded when the user accepts, dismisses, or opens settings for a Multistep Filter suggestion, or when the user ignores the suggestion upon navigating away or closing the tab.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.ByRetention.{RetentionSlice}
histogram.summary: Records the overall user acceptance outcome for a Multistep Filter suggestion, sliced by user retention state when: {RetentionSlice}. Recorded when the user accepts, dismisses, or opens settings for a suggestion, or when the user ignores it.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Acceptance.ByTask.{TaskType}

Recorded when the user accepts, dismisses, or opens settings for a Multistep Filter suggestion, or when the user ignores the suggestion upon navigating away or closing the tab.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome
histogram.summary:
Records the overall technical filter application outcome after a user accepts a Multistep Filter suggestion.
- "All filter facets successfully applied" (AllFiltersApplied) means that after the navigation completed, the landing page's URL was successfully parsed, and the extracted filter attributes exactly matched the suggested filters (same keys and values).
- "Not successfully applied" (NotAllFiltersApplied) covers cases where we failed to apply the filters (e.g., the extraction failed, or the navigation landed on an error page or unsupported scheme).
- "Abandoned before verification" (AbandonedBeforeVerification) covers cases where the user navigated away (back, browser navigation, tab closed, or new suggestion accepted) before the extraction process finished verifying the applied filters.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome.ByRetention.{RetentionSlice}
histogram.summary:
Records the overall technical filter application outcome after a user accepts a Multistep Filter suggestion, sliced by user retention state when: {RetentionSlice}.
- "All filter facets successfully applied" (AllFiltersApplied) means that after the navigation completed, the landing page's URL was successfully parsed, and the extracted filter attributes exactly matched the suggested filters (same keys and values).
- "Not successfully applied" (NotAllFiltersApplied) covers cases where we failed to apply the filters (e.g., the extraction failed, or the navigation landed on an error page or unsupported scheme).
- "Abandoned before verification" (AbandonedBeforeVerification) covers cases where the user navigated away (back, browser navigation, tab closed, or new suggestion accepted) before the extraction process finished verifying the applied filters.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary:
Records the overall technical filter application outcome after a user accepts a Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}.
- "All filter facets successfully applied" (AllFiltersApplied) means that after the navigation completed, the landing page's URL was successfully parsed, and the extracted filter attributes exactly matched the suggested filters (same keys and values).
- "Not successfully applied" (NotAllFiltersApplied) covers cases where we failed to apply the filters (e.g., the extraction failed, or the navigation landed on an error page or unsupported scheme).
- "Abandoned before verification" (AbandonedBeforeVerification) covers cases where the user navigated away (back, browser navigation, tab closed, or new suggestion accepted) before the extraction process finished verifying the applied filters.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.ApplicationOutcome.ByTask.{TaskType}.ByFacet.{FacetType}
histogram.summary:
Records the application outcome (success or failure) for the {FacetType} filter facet when it was part of an accepted Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}.
Note that we only measure the overall application outcome: a facet is recorded as successfully applied (true) if and only if all facets in the accepted suggestion were successfully applied (i.e. the landing page's URL was parsed and all suggested attributes matched). If any facet fails to apply, or if the navigation/extraction fails, all facets in the suggestion are recorded as failed (false).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsShown
histogram.summary: Records the number of filter facets (attributes) contained within a Multistep Filter suggestion when the suggestion is successfully shown to the user (e.g. when the suggestion cue UI is displayed). Only recorded if at least one facet is present.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsShown.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary: Records the number of filter facets (attributes) contained within a Multistep Filter suggestion when the suggestion is successfully shown to the user (e.g. when the suggestion cue UI is displayed) for task type {TaskType}. Only recorded if at least one facet is present.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsSuccessfullyApplied
histogram.summary:
Records the number of filter facets (attributes) that were successfully applied after the user accepted a Multistep Filter suggestion.
Note that this is only recorded when the overall suggestion application succeeds (i.e., all facets in the suggestion were successfully applied to the landing page). If the application fails (e.g. if any facet mismatch occurs or the navigation fails), nothing is recorded to this histogram (we do not log 0).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.NumberOfFacetsSuccessfullyApplied.ByTask.{TaskType}
histogram.summary:
Records the number of filter facets (attributes) that were successfully applied after the user accepted a Multistep Filter suggestion for task type {TaskType}.
Note that this is only recorded when the overall suggestion application succeeds (i.e., all facets in the suggestion were successfully applied to the landing page). If the application fails (e.g. if any facet mismatch occurs or the navigation fails), nothing is recorded to this histogram (we do not log 0).

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.PostSuggestionApplication.UserEngagement
histogram.summary:
Records the user's post-acceptance engagement behavior (tab close, navigation via omnibox/bookmark, back navigation, or forward navigation).
This is recorded after a Multistep Filter suggestion is accepted, either after it is successfully verified (applied), or when the user abandons the load before verification finishes (e.g., by closing the tab or going back).
This is NOT recorded for technical application failures (extraction failures or error page navigations).
Categorizes the behavior into:
- Engaged (within / after) the session window by performing further on-page navigation.
- Abandoned (within / after) the session window by:
a) Tab closure (default 2 minutes for within).
b) Navigating via omnibox/bookmark.
c) Navigating via pressing the back button.
d) A new suggestion overriding the active session.
This helps measure user engagement after applying a suggestion. Recorded when the tab is closed, when the user navigates via omnibox/bookmark, when the user navigates back, when the user performs a forward navigation on the page, or when a new suggestion application overrides the active session.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.SuggestionAge.Accepted
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in minutes) from when a possible Multistep Filter suggestion is extracted from a page to when the user accepts it. Recorded at the moment the user selects the "Accept" action on the suggestion.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.SuggestionAge.AcceptedOnSameDomain
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in minutes) from when a possible Multistep Filter suggestion is extracted from a page to when the user accepts it on the same domain where it was extracted. Recorded at the moment the user selects the "Accept" action on the suggestion.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.SuggestionAge.Shown
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in minutes) from when a possible Multistep Filter suggestion is extracted from a page to when it is first shown to the user. Recorded at the moment the suggestion UI cue is shown.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.SuggestionAge.ShownOnSameDomain
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in minutes) from when a possible Multistep Filter suggestion is extracted from a page to when it is first shown to the user on the same domain where it was extracted. Recorded at the moment the suggestion UI cue is shown.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Time.NavigationToSuggestionAccepted
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in milliseconds) from the end of the navigation that triggered the Multistep Filter suggestion to when the user accepts the suggestion. Recorded when the user selects the "Accept" action.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Time.NavigationToSuggestionShown
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in milliseconds) from the end of the navigation that triggered the Multistep Filter suggestion to when the suggestion UI cue is first shown to the user. Recorded when the suggestion UI is shown.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Time.SuggestionAcceptanceToApplied
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in milliseconds) from when the user accepts a Multistep Filter suggestion to when the landing navigation finishes. It is only recorded when the filters are successfully verified as applied, and does not include the verification time itself.

histogram.name: MultistepFilter.Time.SuggestionShownToAccepted
histogram.summary: Measures the time elapsed (in milliseconds) from when the Multistep Filter suggestion UI cue is shown to when the user accepts it. Recorded when the user selects the "Accept" action.
